newsitem.title: UK: HK shares in London weak as FTSE, Dow fall.
newsitem.headline: HK shares in London weak as FTSE, Dow fall.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London turned lower on Friday, weighed by losses in Hong Kong, a weaker FTSE and an early sell-off on the Dow, dealers said.

The Hang Seng London Reference Index was 89.15 points lower at 11,069.87 by 1412 GMT, in thin trade. "The market has just drifted off this afternoon," said one trader. "We're just following the U.S. bond market and the (Wall) Street at the moment....there's not a lot of volume."
Shares started weaker after the Hang Seng lost 169.19 points to end at 11,159.02.
"We just followed on from that," said one dealer.
Traders said interest was thin, noting a lack of demand for recently firm stocks, notably HSBC Holdings.
The shares were down HK$2 at HK$132.75 in London after closing at HK$133.5 in Hong Kong.
"One surprising feature has been the lack of demand for Hong Kong & Shanghai Bank today," one trader said. "We're down 20p on the day and there's still no interest."
